name: Direction set at 10:00, then a 38% retracement that turns
why: Trend traders buy a 38.2% retracement of the morning move once it turns back. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_direction_first.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && abs(at(10,0) - open) > 0.25 * atr && ((sign(at(10,0) - open) > 0 && (hod - px) >= 0.382 * (hod - open) && px > open && cl(5,1) > op(5,1)) || (sign(at(10,0) - open) < 0 && (px - lod) >= 0.382 * (open - lod) && px < open && cl(5,1) < op(5,1)))
